entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press 1. For technical support, press 2. To speak with a representative about a new purchase or return, press 3.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I, uh, I need to make a return. I have my order number if you need it.
I can certainly help with that. Could you please provide the order number for me?
Yes, it's VF886-0912. It's about the cycling shoes I bought.

Okay, I see the order here for the Road Pro cycling shoes, delivered about 56 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I just... I'm so disappointed. I saved up for these. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years. But no matter what I do, they give me terrible blisters on my heels. I even tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, and the fit just feels all wrong. I really hoped these would work out.
I'm very sorry to hear that they aren't working for you. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Fit is so important with cycling shoes.
It is. I just feel so bad about it, but I really need the money back. I can't justify keeping them if I can't wear them.

I completely understand. Let me just check our policy for you... Okay, I see here that you are well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you. There's no problem at all.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Alex.

Of course. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
